> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly retracts both authoritative merge-latch forms before ambiguity convergence exposes the human-owned park, preserves the required dequeue-before-disable ordering, and fails closed when the proof re-read cannot establish that both latch forms are absent. The implementation leaves explicit needs-user escalations and ordinary state transitions outside this new GraphQL dependency as intended. The added self-tests exercise the real latch parser and mutation dispatcher through process seams, assert operation ordering and no-write refusal, cover idempotent mutation failure, and use literal external mutation names so the principal assertions are not tautological. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
